rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying something is excellent, exciting, or awesome.

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 ging6 wo3

rows.note: Use this casual choice when “awesome” means especially good or enjoyable.

example.english: Having hot pot tonight is awesome!
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 sik6 fo2 wo1 zeng3 aa3

rows.note: Use this when an impressive sight or experience is awe-inspiring or emotionally overwhelming rather than simply excellent.

example.english: Standing on the mountaintop watching the sunrise, the view is truly awesome.
example.traditional: 企喺山頂睇日出，個景象真係好震撼。
example.jyutping: kei5 hai2 saan1 deng2 tai2 jat6 ceot1 go3 ging2 zoeng6 zan1 hai6 hou2 zan3 ham6
